title: Minimum Processing Capacity
description: A sequence of jobs must be processed in order within a fixed number of days. Each day can process a contiguous group of jobs whose total workload does not exceed the machine capacity. Find the minimum capacity needed.
inputFormat: First line: n and days. Second line: n positive job workloads.
outputFormat: Print the minimum machine capacity required.
hints: Binary search the capacity. For a candidate capacity, greedily determine how many days are required.

examples.explanation: Capacity 14 can schedule the jobs as 7+2+5, 10, and 8.
Two days require two jobs of workload 5 each per day.
